verdict.rationale: WorkOS supports M2M applications for issuing API access credentials to third parties/agents (workos-docs-32), and AuthKit acts as a spec-compliant OAuth authorization server for MCP access, implying scoped OAuth grants for AI agents (workos-docs-8, workos-docs-27, workos-docs-9). Custom RBAC roles/permissions can further restrict access at the org/tenant level (workos-docs-22, workos-docs-40). However, there is no explicit documentation of fine-grained scope definitions or least-privilege token minting specifically tailored for agent workloads (e.g., scope lists, token TTL controls for agents). Missing for 10: explicit least-privilege scope configuration for agent credentials, documented examples of restricting an agent's API surface, and independent verification of this in practice.
